proposals: Camera darkness/rain dropouts: on many wet winter evenings (e.g. 2024-06-01 17:00 to 06-02 07:30, 2024-06-14, 2025-05-22) every zone of counter 315 reads 0 from dusk to dawn while ~100-300 bikes would usually pass; a tool that flags counter-wide zero stretches starting at dusk on rainy days, compared against a nearby non-camera counter (site 158), would let reviewers decide whether these are camera blindness (set missing) or real low riding.

summary: Camera 315 at Alison Rd and Doncaster Ave reports every bike twice in zones 446, 447 and 448 (all counts even over the whole record, double the natural variance), so these are scaled by 0.5, while the crossing zone 445 is counted normally. The camera failed on 2024-11-07 at 17:00: three zones then stopped, and 447 published zeros until 2024-11-21 09:45, which is set missing. Riders moved abruptly between the crossing, path and road zones in July and October 2024 while nearby site 158 stayed steady, most likely construction diversions, so these shifts are recorded as uncertain and not changed.
